status: data and adapter readiness; no neural training or task evaluation yet
study_question: With the same worker, memory bank and context budget, does goal plus observed progress/failures improve memory selection and actual task outcomes?

upstream_train_partition.grouping: domain + normalized initial request; semantic family independence not established

worker_model: Qwen3.5-4B fixed candidate; tool-use readiness not yet tested with real model
schedule: once before each nonterminal user turn; no retrieval inside the following tool loop
selector_input_allowlist: prior observed canonical conversation including completed tool calls
direct_effect_measurement: requires capture and independent cloning of complete environment and simulator state before selection; saved prefixes alone are not resumable
end_to_end_measurement: same initial tasks, fixed worker/bank and repeated policy runs; subsequent trajectories may diverge
official_protocol_distinction: controlled injection schedule and token cap are our variant; no official leaderboard claim
training_gate: do not train on raw errors, following actions, or assistant claims as utility gold; first validate memory source conditions and actual paired effects on train-derived states
confirmatory_gate: freeze bank, representations, worker, selection parameters and metrics before held-out task execution; retain all preregistered tasks including neutral/failing ones
previous_evaluations: ConvoMem/AMA stay as retrieval regression evidence; do not discard their negative results

pre_live_representation_checks.required: review evidence-preserving units shared by all selectors; fix selector input cap and truncation on development; report lost evidence
